title: The cryopanel model's operating point is a declared input, not an import
note: Cut C5: the three constants cryopanel_dynamics_3d imported from species_accounting_3d (and with them the mode ontology) are an OperatingPoint the caller declares; the canonical one comes from species_accounting_3d. CP9 puts the import back and the C1 test must see it.

mutations.name: CP1_the_methane_pressure_is_fixed
mutations.rationale: the declared Mode-B pressure is ignored for a hard-coded one

mutations.name: CP2_the_helium_pressure_is_fixed
mutations.rationale: the declared He dose pressure is ignored

mutations.name: CP3_the_dose_window_is_fixed
mutations.rationale: the declared dose window is ignored

mutations.name: CP4_any_operating_point_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a zero, negative or non-finite pressure or window is accepted

mutations.name: CP5_zero_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a zero pressure silently turns a capture phase into a no-op

mutations.name: CP6_a_boolean_is_a_number
mutations.find: if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) \
mutations.rationale: True is accepted as a pressure of 1 Pa

mutations.name: CP8_the_canonical_point_swaps_two_pressures
mutations.rationale: the campaign runs at an operating point that is not the canonical one

mutations.name: CP9_the_ontology_import_returns
mutations.replace:
from .surface_coverage import kinetic_flux
from . import species_accounting_3d  # noqa: F401
mutations.rationale: importing the cryopanel model loads the mode ontology again (the C1 residual, back)
